summary: Team membership information returned on API level based on ID
description:
### Impact

After guessing a 62^15 complex unique identifier, a malicious logged in user was able to retrieve a list of memberships for a circle they are not a member of.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 32.0.12, 33.0.6 or 34.0.1
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 32.0.12, 33.0.6 or 34.0.1

### Workarounds

* Disable app circles

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3484601)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/circles/pull/2522)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)

summary: Write-share collaborator can place a TYPE_TOKEN lock that permanently denies the file owner
description:
### Impact

File owners were unable to unlock `TYPE_TOKEN `locks placed by other users, leaving files permanently locked with no recovery path outside of the database.

### Patches

summary: Unauthenticated Persistent Denial-of-Service via Federated Share Injection
description:
### Impact

Abusing the federated share endpoint, an attacker can write arbitrary rows into the oc_share_external database table. These rows persist indefinitely — there is no automatic cleanup mechanism. Three distinct denial-of-service conditions follow from this write primitive, all triggered from the same unauthenticated source and all self-renewing on a 24-hour cycle for as long as the injected rows remain in the database.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 34.0.2 or 33.0.7 or 32.0.13
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 34.0.2 or 33.0.7 or 32.0.13

### Workarounds

* Disable receiving federated sharing

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3679640)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/62091)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:
